title: "Content Aware" Photoshop
content: (Video Link) Adobe Photoshop shows off its "content aware" features, which make it possible to move elements around with only a rough selection. The photo-editing software removes the original element and fills in the background using intelligent analysis of adjacent pixels.--------ViaBest of YouTubeAdobe Photoshop Extended CS5 Upsell-------By the way, thanks, Susan Fox for mentioning GurneyJourney onyour blog!
